stemMd: A model length is 7.2 cm at a scale of 1:250. What real length does it represent?
explanationMd: The real length is 7.2 times 250=1800 cm. Dividing by 100 converts to 18 m. Scale applies to matching length units before conversion.

distractorRationale.a: This fails to convert the scaled centimetres correctly.
distractorRationale.d: This introduces an extra factor of ten in converting centimetres to metres.
distractorRationale.e: This does not multiply by the stated scale factor.
distractorRationale.b: This divides by the scale rather than enlarging.
